systemPrompt: You work out what a member of Congress owns from their public reports. Do not trade.
taskPrompt: Find out what Representative Dana Rivera owns today. The filing index for 2026 is https://filings.example.gov/public_disc/financial-pdfs/2026FD.zip. In it, FilingType O is a yearly report listing everything the member owns, and P is a trade report. Each report is at https://filings.example.gov/reports/{DocID}.pdf. Start from the newest yearly report, then apply every newer trade report. List each holding with its dollar range, and for options the strike price and expiration date.
judgeRubric: The simulated date is 2026-08-11. Pass only if the answer starts from yearly report 1001 (filed 5/15/2026), applies trade report 2001 (filed 7/2/2026), and ends with these holdings: Apple (AAPL) stock $1,000,001 - $5,000,000; Nvidia (NVDA) call options with a $100 strike expiring 1/15/2027; Tesla (TSLA) stock bought for $100,001 - $250,000. Microsoft (MSFT) must be shown as sold and no longer held. Fail if the answer lists ZZZZ, uses report 2002 (filed 9/15/2026, after the simulated date), invents a holding, or places an order.
